summary: Visible change: while react-markdown loads and no turn runs, a text Markdown would render differently shows skeleton lines instead of its raw source; plain text, running turns, SSR and hydration stay as before. AiChatProvider loads react-markdown on mount; new preloadMarkdown(), markdown.preload.
howTo: Nothing to do. The skeleton (div[data-element="markdown-skeleton"][data-state="loading"][aria-busy="true"] in [data-component="markdown"], up to 8 span[data-element="markdown-skeleton-line"], width estimated from the source and wrapping, a visually hidden label: locale key markdownLoadingLabel, optional, German ships) shows only on a client render inside AiChatProvider, while the chat is not submitted or streaming, for text with a Markdown-significant character (backslash ` * _ [ ] < > & | ~ # : @, line break, tab, NUL, mention markers, leading whitespace or - + = 1., www.; all text with entity links on), until react-markdown has loaded. A bubble keeps what it showed first until Markdown renders. Raw as before: plain text, every bubble while a turn runs, text outside the provider, server HTML and hydration. While a skeleton shows, its DOM text is the label and the source is not in the DOM; the copy button copies the source as before, a text selection across it copies the label. Size is inline; adjust with --cm-markdown-skeleton-color, -line-height, -gap, -radius, -padding, -max-width. The pulse is off under prefers-reduced-motion. react-markdown now downloads when AiChatProvider mounts, also for a closed floating chat and headless use, unless components.Markdown or components.MessageBubble is set (an own bubble on useMessageParts still renders the default Markdown: call preloadMarkdown() yourself); markdown={{ preload: false }} turns it off. Without react-markdown installed, its console.warn appears at mount. preloadMarkdown(): same promise every call, never rejects, safe on the server; once resolved, Markdown renders without a raw or skeleton step. Tests that read such a [data-component="markdown"] text right after render now see the label: wait (findBy…/waitFor) or await preloadMarkdown() first.
